The KulturPass DE app offers young people a marketplace for cultural offerings in their region, while providing everybody else with inspiration for new cultural experiences.
 
If you turn 18 this year and live in Germany, you receive a budget of 200 Euros via the KulturPass DE app. You can use this to reserve tickets for concerts, theater events or movies. You can also get offers for museums, parks, and exhibitions, plus you can buy books, musical instruments, sheet music, and vinyl records.
 
By selecting preferences during registration, you allow the app to make offers that suit your particular tastes and interests. You can also search for specific offerings. If you don’t find anything to your liking, you can get suggestions from the KulturPass via “Inspire Me”. Or take pot luck by choosing “Feeling Lucky” and maybe experience something completely new!
 
Once you have found something you like, you can reserve it. A QR code is generated which you can use to pick up your reservation, your new favorite book for example, on site. If you reserve tickets, you can often redeem the KulturPass code online. The price is then deducted from your budget.
